notes.text: Claim that MemoryStream.CanRead returns false after Dispose (used for the printed output 'Base open: True, report open: False' and the fixed output 'Base open: False, report open: False'); run-snippets should confirm.

Second link and the analyzer claim: CA2215 is 'Dispose methods should call base class dispose' at https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dotnet/fundamentals/code-analysis/quality-rules/ca2215; verify the URL resolves and the rule title matches.

bugLineSets accepts line 45 (last statement of the override, after which base.Dispose(disposing) belongs) and line 35 (override declaration); line numbers counted from code.source with blank lines at 4, 9, 15, 29, 34.

The derived class declares its own private _disposed field alongside the base private _disposed field; this compiles without CS0108 because the base field is private, mirroring the Microsoft Learn derived-class sample.
